==================
_Atomic (type) specifier in ivars, method params and properties
==================

@interface PWDebugSwitchOption : NSObject
{
@private
    _Atomic (BOOL)* target_;
    NSString*       defaultsKey_;
}

- (instancetype) initWithTarget:(_Atomic (BOOL)*)target defaultValue:(BOOL)value;

@property (nonatomic, readonly)    _Atomic (BOOL)*  target;
@end

==================
extern "C" braces split across preproc guards
==================

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

BOOL isExceptionExpected (NSException* exception);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
